milestones.title: Forked from CrawlScan V1
milestones.text: The open-source CrawlScan engine, audited and made private: scans now stop on time, and the draw and rewards modules are gone.

milestones.title: BNB Chain and Base
milestones.text: four.meme, Flap and Clanker tokens on BNB Chain and Base, with any 0x address located across every enabled chain.

milestones.title: Uniswap and PancakeSwap launches
milestones.text: Tokens launched straight into a Uniswap or PancakeSwap pool are scanned too, on Robinhood, Base and BNB Chain.

milestones.title: History index and coverage
milestones.text: Transfer histories are indexed and resumed between scans, checked against the chain, and every verdict says how complete its data was.

milestones.title: CrawlMeme
milestones.text: One scanner for Robinhood, Solana, Base and BNB Chain memecoins.
